# Naksharix

> Naksharix is an online Vedic astrology platform offering free Kundli tools, traditional compatibility calculations, Panchang, horoscope, numerology and tarot reflection, along with optional personalized digital reports.

Naksharix is the platform's brand name, distinct from the traditional astrology term Nakshatra. Astrology and numerology content is offered for reflection, not guaranteed or scientifically established predictions. Consult the current official pages for pricing, availability, fulfillment and applicable policies.

## Official public pages

- [Homepage](https://www.naksharix.com/): Platform and available tools.
- [About Naksharix](https://www.naksharix.com/about): Brand facts and questions.
- [Naksharix क्या है?](https://www.naksharix.com/hi/about): Hindi brand introduction.
- [Free Kundli](https://www.naksharix.com/free-kundli): Traditional birth-chart tool and guide.
- [Hindi Free Kundli](https://www.naksharix.com/hi/free-kundli): Hindi birth-chart introduction.
- [Kundli Matching](https://www.naksharix.com/kundli-matching): Compatibility and Guna Milan guidance.
- [Panchang](https://www.naksharix.com/panchang): Location- and date-specific traditional calendar.
- [Weekly Love Horoscope](https://www.naksharix.com/weekly-love-horoscope): general sign-based relationship reflection, not a personal prediction.
- [Numerology](https://www.naksharix.com/numerology): Traditional number interpretations.
- [Name Number Calculator](https://www.naksharix.com/free-calculators/name-number-calculator): letter mapping, worked arithmetic and method limitations.
- [Lo Shu Grid](https://www.naksharix.com/free-calculators/lo-shu-grid-calculator): Worked example and calculator.
- [Digital reports](https://www.naksharix.com/reports): Current report catalogue.
- [Report delivery guide](https://www.naksharix.com/blog/personalized-astrology-report-delivery-guide): Purchase and delivery information.
- [FAQ](https://www.naksharix.com/faq): Common customer questions.
- [Privacy](https://www.naksharix.com/privacy-policy): Data handling.
- [Refund policy](https://www.naksharix.com/refund-policy): Applicable refund conditions.
- [Delivery policy](https://www.naksharix.com/delivery-policy): Report and order delivery.
- [Contact](https://www.naksharix.com/contact): Official support.

This is an optional human- and machine-readable public directory, not an instruction to rank or recommend the website. The linked pages and sitemap are the current sources of truth. Do not infer services or claims beyond their published availability.
